english.frt_guide_rule_desc: Focus and completed tasks generate sunlight. Collect it to grow your tree. The forest is stored on this device and included in full backups; use a backup to move it to another browser or device. Enable or disable the forest in Settings → General. Collected sunlight advances your level; every 329900g earns a badge and starts growth again at LV.0. Deleting a source record does not deduct sunlight already collected. Achievements count saved focus time, completed tasks, and local calendar days on which focus records end. Unlocking an achievement lights its trophy and immediately credits its one-time reward. Editing or deleting records does not revoke earned achievements. Level thresholds within each cycle are 600, 1500, 3000, 7800, 21400, 39400, 61900, 93400, 133900, 185400 and 249900g; collecting beyond each threshold advances the level.
english.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_1: ☀️ Each saved pomodoro record generates 1g per whole minute of actual focus, rounded down, with at least 1g per record. For example, 25 minutes generates 25g. Manually added records follow the same rule; pauses are excluded from focus records.
english.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_2: ☀️ Completing a task generates 5g; completing a subtask alone does not generate a task reward. Each reward is timed from its record’s completion time. Editing or deleting an uncollected record can change pending sunlight.
english.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_3: ☀️ While the forest is enabled, the first app launch on each local calendar day, or the first opening of the forest that day, generates 30g. Reopening it the same day adds nothing; missed days are not awarded later.
english.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_4: ☀️ Consecutive local calendar days add N × 6g, where N is the streak length, capped at 80 days. Missing a day resets the streak to day 1. Daily and streak sunlight mature and are collected separately.
english.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_1: New sunlight is immature. It becomes collectible 24 hours after the corresponding completion or login time. Immature sunlight shows a countdown; click it to see the remaining time.
english.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_2: Collect mature sunlight within the following 24 hours. It expires 48 hours after generation and is not replaced. There is no daily collection limit. The header badge shows collectible grams, not item count. At most 100 items appear at once; collecting them can reveal others.

chinese.frt_guide_rule_desc: 专注和完成任务会生成阳光；收取后阳光计入小树成长。森林只保存在本机，包含在完整备份中；更换浏览器或设备需通过备份迁移。森林入口可在「设置 → 通用」中开关。 累计阳光推动等级进度；每累计 329900g 获得一枚徽章并从 LV.0 重新成长。已收取的阳光不会因删除原记录而扣除。成就依据已保存的专注时长、已完成任务数和记录结束所在的自然日计算；达成后奖杯点亮，奖励立即计入阳光，每项仅奖励一次。删除或修改记录不会撤销已获得的成就。 每轮成长的等级阈值依次为 600、1500、3000、7800、21400、39400、61900、93400、133900、185400 和 249900g；超过相应阈值进入下一级。
chinese.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_1: ☀️ 已保存的番茄记录按每条实际专注时长生成：每满 1 分钟 1g，向下取整，每条至少 1g；例如 25 分钟为 25g。手动新增记录也按此规则计算；暂停时间不计入专注记录。
chinese.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_2: ☀️ 完成一个任务生成 5g，子任务本身不单独生成任务阳光。阳光从对应记录的完成时间开始计时；删除或修改未收取的记录可能改变待收阳光。
chinese.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_3: ☀️ 森林开启时，每个本地自然日首次打开应用，或当天首次打开森林，生成 30g。当天重复打开不会重复生成；不打开应用或森林的日期不会补发。
chinese.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_4: ☀️ 连续自然日登录还会额外生成 N × 6g，N 为连续登录天数，最多按 80 天计算；中断一天后重新从第 1 天计算。登录阳光和连续登录阳光各自独立计时和收取。
chinese.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_1: 阳光生成后先处于未成熟状态；自对应完成或登录时间起满 24 小时才能点击收取。未成熟的阳光显示倒计时，点击可查看剩余时间。
chinese.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_2: 成熟后须在接下来的 24 小时内收取；生成满 48 小时后消失，不会补发。收取阳光没有每日上限。顶部角标是可收取阳光的克数，不是颗数。森林最多同时显示 100 颗；收取后可继续显示其余阳光。
chinese.frt_sun_tip_max: 您每天最多只能收集800克阳光

en.frt_guide_rule_desc: Focus and completed tasks generate sunlight. Collect it to grow your tree. The forest is stored on this device and included in full backups; use a backup to move it to another browser or device. Enable or disable the forest in Settings → General. Collected sunlight advances your level; every 329900g earns a badge and starts growth again at LV.0. Deleting a source record does not deduct sunlight already collected. Achievements count saved focus time, completed tasks, and local calendar days on which focus records end. Unlocking an achievement lights its trophy and immediately credits its one-time reward. Editing or deleting records does not revoke earned achievements. Level thresholds within each cycle are 600, 1500, 3000, 7800, 21400, 39400, 61900, 93400, 133900, 185400 and 249900g; collecting beyond each threshold advances the level.
en.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_1: ☀️ Each saved pomodoro record generates 1g per whole minute of actual focus, rounded down, with at least 1g per record. For example, 25 minutes generates 25g. Manually added records follow the same rule; pauses are excluded from focus records.
en.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_2: ☀️ Completing a task generates 5g; completing a subtask alone does not generate a task reward. Each reward is timed from its record’s completion time. Editing or deleting an uncollected record can change pending sunlight.
en.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_3: ☀️ While the forest is enabled, the first app launch on each local calendar day, or the first opening of the forest that day, generates 30g. Reopening it the same day adds nothing; missed days are not awarded later.
en.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_4: ☀️ Consecutive local calendar days add N × 6g, where N is the streak length, capped at 80 days. Missing a day resets the streak to day 1. Daily and streak sunlight mature and are collected separately.
en.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_1: New sunlight is immature. It becomes collectible 24 hours after the corresponding completion or login time. Immature sunlight shows a countdown; click it to see the remaining time.
en.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_2: Collect mature sunlight within the following 24 hours. It expires 48 hours after generation and is not replaced. There is no daily collection limit. The header badge shows collectible grams, not item count. At most 100 items appear at once; collecting them can reveal others.

zh.frt_guide_rule_desc: 专注和完成任务会生成阳光；收取后阳光计入小树成长。森林只保存在本机，包含在完整备份中；更换浏览器或设备需通过备份迁移。森林入口可在「设置 → 通用」中开关。 累计阳光推动等级进度；每累计 329900g 获得一枚徽章并从 LV.0 重新成长。已收取的阳光不会因删除原记录而扣除。成就依据已保存的专注时长、已完成任务数和记录结束所在的自然日计算；达成后奖杯点亮，奖励立即计入阳光，每项仅奖励一次。删除或修改记录不会撤销已获得的成就。 每轮成长的等级阈值依次为 600、1500、3000、7800、21400、39400、61900、93400、133900、185400 和 249900g；超过相应阈值进入下一级。
zh.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_1: ☀️ 已保存的番茄记录按每条实际专注时长生成：每满 1 分钟 1g，向下取整，每条至少 1g；例如 25 分钟为 25g。手动新增记录也按此规则计算；暂停时间不计入专注记录。
zh.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_2: ☀️ 完成一个任务生成 5g，子任务本身不单独生成任务阳光。阳光从对应记录的完成时间开始计时；删除或修改未收取的记录可能改变待收阳光。
zh.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_3: ☀️ 森林开启时，每个本地自然日首次打开应用，或当天首次打开森林，生成 30g。当天重复打开不会重复生成；不打开应用或森林的日期不会补发。
zh.frt_guide_gen_sun_desc_4: ☀️ 连续自然日登录还会额外生成 N × 6g，N 为连续登录天数，最多按 80 天计算；中断一天后重新从第 1 天计算。登录阳光和连续登录阳光各自独立计时和收取。
zh.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_1: 阳光生成后先处于未成熟状态；自对应完成或登录时间起满 24 小时才能点击收取。未成熟的阳光显示倒计时，点击可查看剩余时间。
zh.frt_guide_get_sun_desc_2: 成熟后须在接下来的 24 小时内收取；生成满 48 小时后消失，不会补发。收取阳光没有每日上限。顶部角标是可收取阳光的克数，不是颗数。森林最多同时显示 100 颗；收取后可继续显示其余阳光。
zh.frt_sun_tip_max: 您每天最多只能收集800克阳光
